question: What is the meaning of toxicity in relation to health and safety aspects?
description: Toxicity in relation to health and safety aspects refers to the harmful effects that certain substances can have on human health. This includes substances that can cause cancer, genetic mutations, impair fertility, harm unborn children, interfere with the hormonal system, target specific organs, affect respiratory health, cause skin sensitization or allergic reactions.
